novels.author: Guiltythree
novels.title: Shadow Slave
novels.description: Growing up in poverty, Sunny never expected anything good from life. However, even he did not anticipate being chosen by the Nightmare Spell and becoming one of the Awakened - an elite group of people gifted with supernatural powers. Transported into a ruined magical world, he found himself facing against terrible monsters - and other Awakened - in a deadly battle of survival. What's worse, the divine power he received happened to possess a small, but potentially fatal side effect...

novels.author: Guiltythree
novels.title: Shadow Slave Novel
novels.description: From humble beginnings to extraordinary power, Sunny's life transforms when the Nightmare Spell awakens his latent abilities, marking him as one of the Awakened—an exclusive cadre wielding supernatural gifts. Cast into a shattered magical realm, he battles monstrous threats and rival Awakened in a brutal struggle for existence. Yet his divine gift carries a hidden curse: a devastating flaw that could prove his undoing.

novels.author: RicoThePencil
novels.title: Shadow Slave: Foreign shadow
novels.description:
What would you do if one day you found yourself in the world of Shadow Slave?
Would you try to change the outcome or would you just follow the script?
Are you brave enough to take the lead or would you simply step aside and enjoy life?
You are Sunless, and also, you know the plot until the volume 10. It's not so bad, am I wrong?
However... what if you found yourself in the world of Shadow Slave as Sunless, but the story is a 'little' different than the one you know?
Let's find out!

novels.author: bad_gamer_novels
novels.title: shadow slave monarch of crimson
novels.description:
Most stories start the same way.
You either have the slum rat who claws his way out of the mud, drenched in blood and sweat until he becomes a god… or the golden child, heir to some ancient clan — fallen or thriving, it doesn’t matter. Either way, they’re destined for greatness.
Alucard was destined for death.
In the original Shadow Slave timeline, his fate was sealed: die in his very first Nightmare. As Rain’s adoptive older brother — just as close and beloved as the canon one — his tragedy was meant to end there.
But fate made a mistake.
Alucard survived the Nightmare he was [Fated] to die in… and the price of that survival was a path no human should ever walk — a path paved with death, sin, and horrors beyond mortal understanding.
To claim even a fragment of salvation, he must defy the destiny written for him.
He must face terrors that twist reality, monsters born from blood and hatred, and the sins that cling to his soul like chains.
This is the story of a man who should not exist
a man who was never meant to defy fate
and a man who will do whatever it takes to protect the ones he loves

novels.author: true_visionary
novels.title: shadow slave: Avatar of Apocalypse
novels.description:
The Shadow brought mystery upon the world, cloaking fate itself in endless dusk.
The Sun placed flames of passion and destruction into mortal hands, blessing humanity with both warmth and ruin.
The Dreaming One foresaw all things long before they came to pass, and through the eyes of a blind oracle, gazed upon the weaving threads of destiny.
The Heart offered its own heart to a lover, not for itself, but for all mankind.
The Sun was destined to usher forth an apocalypse... yet War devoured the Sun itself, only to forge that apocalypse into something far greater, far more terrible.
And amidst the turning of fate—
Senrix was nothing more than an ordinary human from Earth, a boy who had never even read Shadow Slave. He knew of the story only through fleeting videos scattered across TikTok.
Yet destiny mocked reason.
Transmigrated into a world of nightmares as the son of the first Saint of the War Realm and a child blessed by the Nightmare Spell itself, he would walk a path stained by blood, ruin, and prophecy.
He shall be the first to arrive...
...and the last to leave.

novels.author: FlameReaver
novels.title: Shadow Slave: Shadow of Blood
novels.description:
Ravensong lived with more regrets then most. Fate require it for her to break many promises...
But this one... She wouldn't break.
Little did she knew that saving her friend's son would change the course of Fate.
That her new son would become the Heir of Death itself...
That Changing Star would question her revenge...
That Song of the Fallen would carry a burden never ment to be hers...

novels.author: MonoSilence
novels.title: Shadow Slave | Sleepless Dreamer
novels.description:
Set in the Shadow Slave world...a time before Sunny was born...this story follows a simple soldier who must survive in a dystopian, apocalyptic landscape where magic and gun warfare collide.
In a far-off Quadrant known as North America, a young soldier named Hope is 16 years old when he gets infected by the Nightmare Spell. He passed! But...he feels a bit scammed...?
A flaw that makes him fade from people's memories...
A cursed attribute that makes him remember everything endlessly in eternal wakefulness...
It's as if the Spell is twisting his future and existence into an almost improbable one.
All he has ever known his purpose to be was to serve as a simple soldier. Not too powerful. But not so weak either. And maybe, just maybe like some others, become an Awakened. Although he never dreamt of being one.
Now that his whole life is compromised after his First Nightmare, his first objective is to survive on his own. But as he tries to escape his fate, his actions seem to lead him further from his goal.
He struggles against obstacles that slowly grow bigger and out of proportion.
Maybe the Dream Realm and the Real World aren't so different than one may think.
Hope's journey involves uncovering secrets and gaining knowledge about his true nature and his new role in the world.
Is he fit to be a hero?
Could he redefine it?
***
Please read the READER DISCLAIMER in Volume 0.
This is my spin-off novel of “Shadow Slave” by Guiltythree.
But please don't expect the same writing style, setting, and characters, especially the main character.
This story reveals more about how people/cities/governments operate after the Spell’s arrival. I always find it interesting how maybe one country handles it fairly, but how others handle it with desperation to the point that you question humanity.
There will be easter eggs pointing to the original novel either intentional for the plot or unrelated to it, but all for fun.
I am a new author so props to all who bear with me and helps me improve my writing. If it is not for you, please don't leave outright hate comments. Eat wassabi instead if you want pain. Critique and advice would be great too.

novels.author: MonoSilence
novels.title: Shadow Slave | Sleepless Dreamer Novel
novels.description:
In a Quadrant known as North America, a 16-year-old soldier named Hope encounters the Nightmare Spell—an infection that forever alters his existence. The curse grants him an agonizing gift: an endless capacity to remember every moment with perfect clarity, while simultaneously causing the world to forget he exists. His life, once defined by simple military purpose, shatters under the weight of this contradiction.
Born into a dystopian realm where magic and gunfire shape survival, Hope never dreamed of becoming Awakened. Yet the Spell's twisted effects thrust him into a journey he never chose, where each decision seems to pull him further from safety rather than toward it. As obstacles grow increasingly insurmountable, he begins questioning whether the Dream Realm and reality operate by different rules entirely.
Set before Sunny's arrival in the Shadow Slave universe, this story chronicles Hope's struggle to understand his cursed nature and uncover his true role in a transformed world. Is he capable of heroism? Can he redefine what it means to be legendary?
This spin-off explores how civilization adapts to the Spell's devastation across different nations—some pursuing justice while others descend into desperation that challenges human morality. Easter eggs and references to the original narrative are scattered throughout, blending canon elements with this unique perspective. As a debut author's work, this novel prioritizes character-driven storytelling and worldbuilding depth over stylistic similarity to its source material. Constructive feedback and critique are appreciated as this author grows.

novels.author: NobleQueenBee
novels.title: The Noble Queen-A Shadow Slave Fanfic
novels.description:
Volumes I-III are complete! The story is finished for now.
Queen Bee may have lost to Mongrel in the Dreamscape, but that is not where her story ends. Nor is it where her journey began. Get a deeper glimpse into the waking world of Shadow Slave through the eyes of one of the Dreamscape's top duelists.
Special thanks to Guiltythree for all his help with the lore. I appreciate your time very much!
Also thanks to Nonsensefree, the story's content editor. You made my life much easier. Thank you!

novels.author: BloodyCrown11
novels.title: Shadow Slave : A Moment of Weakness
novels.description:
Atop the Crimson Spire, a treacherous shadow and a radiant angel fought. Normally, the shadow would win, only to realize he had been fooled and ultimately forced to leave the angel behind.
It was the predestined path, the correct one, the one that would lead to the best possible end. However, a moment of weakness was all it took to send it all crashing down.
Plans long in the making were made impossible, salvation became uncertain, and amidst it all, Fate would not be denied.

novels.author: kreakerss
novels.title: Shadow Slave: Not a very laid back life.
novels.description:
Ladies and gents, welcome to the world of Shadow Slave—where nightmare creatures lurk in every shadow of the Dream Realm, yeaning to feed on the minds and bodies of the Awakened who dare to venture. Humanity? Oh, they're hanging on by a thread, slowly being swallowed by the Nightmare Spell.
Our MC? Meet Asher — a clueless idiot who one day gets transported into Shadow Slave. Is he terrified? Worried about being mauled by some monstrous beast? Not at all. This dumbass is thrilled to be inside his favorite novel.
He is a walking red flag for natural selection!
Like, IS he right on the mind? NO!
So, what now? Want to follow this idiot’s journey through the world of shadow slave?
yeah? That's what I thought!
Then what are you waiting for? Read it already!
(NO actually, read it!)
[All credit goes to G3 the GOAT and grammarly my wonderful editor]

novels.title: [MHA x Shadow Slave]: Lurker at the Threshold
novels.description:

From a bum, who stumbled through life, into a panentheistic god wannabe. Starting from a typical trope of a guy who happens to enjoy novels and other cultured works and gets yeeted into another world... only to get yeeted into another world once again!

novels.author: nagi_kurose
novels.title: Shadow Slave:The legacy fallen in a world of nightmares
novels.description: What if a regular human from our world ended up in Shadow Slave with a pretty average Aspect? Could they really take on monsters flexing divine Aspects, divine bloodlines, and completely broken powers? Would they be able to adapt and take down those abominations without losing their mind? Or better yet… would they even survive long enough to adapt to that world?

novels.author: kreakerss
novels.title: Shadow Slave: Not a very laid back life. Novel
novels.description:
In the Dream Realm, nightmare creatures emerge from darkness itself, feasting on the minds and bodies of the Awakened. Humanity teeters on the brink of extinction, consumed by the relentless Nightmare Spell that spreads across their world.
Asher finds himself thrust into Shadow Slave—the very novel he once read—yet his response defies logic. Rather than fear the monstrous horrors stalking every shadow, he embraces his new reality with reckless enthusiasm. Oblivious to the danger surrounding him, he charges forward with the survival instincts of a character written for tragedy.
His decisions defy reason. His luck defies explanation. His story defies every conventional expectation of what survival means in a world designed to devour the unprepared.
Follow Asher as he stumbles through a nightmare landscape where each choice could be his last, where monsters lurk in every shadow, and where being transported into your favorite novel proves far deadlier than fiction ever suggested. In a realm where only the cunning endure, watch an idiot somehow persist.
His journey through Shadow Slave awaits—a tale of action, mystery, and supernatural horror intertwined with unexpected comedy and romance. Enter the darkness. Discover how long an unprepared soul can survive in a world designed for his demise.
